field.label: Host
field.help: One IPv4 or IPv6 address, or a MAC address. A MAC's addresses are taken from the firewall's host discovery at each read, so a device keeps one quota for IPv4 and IPv6 while its IPv6 addresses change; behind a router the firewall sees the router's MAC, so name such a host by its address. The firewall's own addresses are never counted or blocked.

field.label: Volume (MB)
field.help: Megabytes the host may move in a cycle, both ways together and to the firewall itself too (1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes; 1000 is 1 GB). Empty: no volume limit.

field.label: Time (minutes of use)
field.help: Minutes of use the host may have in a cycle: minutes in which it moved more than Settings' Minute of use above. Empty: no time limit.

field.label: Cycle
field.help: When the count starts again from nothing, in the firewall's time zone: a host blocked by this quota passes again then.
